preconditions.description: The number of greetings n is between 1 and 750 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(greeting) <= 10000000 for greeting in greetings)
preconditions.description: Each greeting consists of between 1 and 10,000,000 characters inclusive.
Each greeting consists only of the characters 'a' and 'b'.
The total length of all greetings does not exceed 10,000,000 characters.

postconditions.description: The size of the stylish set is between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(i in range(1, n+1) for i in result_set)
postconditions.description: Each number in the result set is a valid ribbon number between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(not (greetings[i-1] in greetings[j-1]) for i in result_set for j in result_set if i != j)
postconditions.description: No greeting in the stylish set is a substring of another greeting in the stylish set.

postconditions.expression: not any(all(greetings[i-1] in greetings[j-1] for j in result_set) for i in range(1, n+1) if i not in result_set)
postconditions.description: No greeting outside the stylish set is a substring of any greeting in the stylish set.
